answer: Audits are entered in mirror, queued in horizon, and quill publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 15 identities per epoch. A farm of 149 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2068 identities would post 4778 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
